versions.subject: Merge PR #5090 from @CheraghiMilad - add rule for impair system power settings
versions.detection:
selection_systemctl:
    Image|endswith: '/systemctl'
    CommandLine|contains: ' mask'
selection_power_options:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'suspend.target'
        - 'hibernate.target'
        - 'hybrid-sleep.target'
condition: all of selection_*
